verdict.tagline: A subversive RPG where choices genuinely shape the journey.

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Early players find the initial pacing slow and confusing.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the opening section of the game as slow and confusing.

citations.review_text: Probably one of those games where you either like or you don't. Unfortunately, I found the beginning to be slow and confusing, and after I cleared the prologue, I found the humour grating. DNF.

the game is quite entertaining; although it might start off a bit boring or even confusing it becomes much more engaging as u delve deeper into the story (depending, of course, on the path you choose) it also teaches the value of determination the importance of persevering even through difficult times and shows u how to be strong, believe me, that’s something that will make a huge difference in ur real life, that’s why I feel that, beyond just being a good game, it offers a beautiful lesson that we should all learn :)

single_points.text: One reviewer says the control scheme is based around arrow keys and ZXC and the game does not allow rebinding controls.

citation.review_text:
Has a very obscure control scheme based around arrow keys and ZXC that's awkward to play with. This wouldn't be a problem, except [b]the game doesn't allow rebinding controls[/b]. I use a keyboard that doesn't have a standard arrow key layout, so it's unplayable.

There are ways around this, with keyboard rebinds or scripts, but I'd rather refund games that lack such basic functionality.

citation.review_text: This game is so much fun and very hard. But one thing to ask undertail is, why do you have to get to a save point witch they are very far apart and they take a while and can be a little anoying for when you have to get off to do something. But other then that the game is really fun.

cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Longer-term players praise the branching storylines and unique combat system.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that player choices and actions impact the story and lead to multiple different endings.

citations.review_text: This is 100% one of the best games I have ever played. This game is so stinking cool I swear I love this game. You really get some like bone tingling moments. Depending on what route you play, the game can be REALLY emotional and REALLY hard, and this is a great game for all people. I've been playing the genocide route (where you kill every enemy) and lets just say some of these bosses are on another level. And also the fact how when you kill people decides the fate of the story and the underground is absolutely awesome. Once again, I 100% recommend this game for EVERYONE. Definitely worth the 10 dollars.
I like that there is multiple different routes and that your actions matter

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the combat system as unique and engaging, keeping encounters fresh.

citations.review_text: Sad that i can't fuck Toriel but yeah it lives up to the hype. All of the characters are funny and charming, I love the amount of detail packed into every little interaction you have with an npc, the game finds new and fun ways to keep the combat fresh, the music is great, and its emotional parts his like a truck. 10/10, would recommend to anyone.

This game is amazing. It literally tests you and I envy those who went in blind.

Soundtrack: A masterpiece, you probably heard this before as background music in YouTube videos or TikToks but that doesn't do it justice. If you like classical music and don't hate old fashioned video game music you will love this.
10/10

Graphics: Simple 2D pixel art, however the art style is amazing and the low graphics means this game will run on almost anything.

Story: Brilliant and a mix of light hearted comedy with dark and depressing themes, however there might be more or less disturbing content depending on how you play, and it feels like a different game on different routes. The messaging is impactful and impossible to miss. The characters are some of the best in fiction, no one is "the bad guy" it's not all black and white.
10/10

Gameplay: The gameplay is simple with some puzzles which may be challenging but overall its not the main focus. However the combat system is actually pretty good and unique.
8/10

Bugs: There are a few but I've never encountered any yet. Most bugs are accounted for and have in game reactions. Nothing game breaking.

Easter Eggs: There are a lot of these and are done without breaking immersion.
10/10

Flaws: One of my biggest gripes with "Undertale" is the "dating", basically you play as a child but some characters can be befriended and you can go on hangouts but if you choose to flirt with them in battle it is referred to as a date. Most of these are not weird but I have felt uncomfortable before. I think this is supposed to be a joke but still it remains my only complaint. I think it is still worth playing.

Overall It's an unforgettable experience that everyone should try even if it's not perfect, it is as close as possible.
